title: Sarofang Prime
extract:
Sarofang Prime is the primed variant of  Sarofang, acting as a direct upgrade. Sarofang Prime was released alongside  Voruna Prime and  Perigale Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Rending Crane and  Noble Cadence (Conclave only) stance.
Performing a Heavy Attack Slam with an 8x Combo Multiplier (5x with  Voruna ( Prime)) briefly pulls enemies within 9m toward the center of the slam.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Highest critical multiplier of all heavy blades.
